description: A bearded man in a gold-trimmed horned crown and fringed, embroidered robes sits on a carved wooden throne in a dim hall, gesturing with one hand. A kneeling man in a plain tunic and headband holds up a gold-cased rolled scroll toward him, and a second man at right holds a clay tablet marked with wedge-like script. Through a stone arch behind them is a walled city with a stepped tower and a river. Carved reliefs cover the walls, and a torch burns at the left edge. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible legible text.
